## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Behavior matches the referenced design section(s)
- [ ] Design-derived tests or manual acceptance steps are added
- [ ] User control / privacy impact reviewed
- [ ] Safety / permission impact reviewed
- [ ] Token / compute / external cost impact reviewed
- [ ] Documentation remains consistent

Stop implementation. Update `docs/OUR_HOME_DESIGN.md` first, review the design change, then return to this Issue.
